annotations.title: EU Cross-Border VAT Rate & Reverse-Charge Calculator API

description: EU Cross-Border VAT Rate & Reverse-Charge Calculator API: Determine exact EU VAT rates, B2B reverse charge, EN 16931 tax category codes, and mandatory invoice legal text. (Endpoint: POST /v1/eu-vat-calculator)

amount.description: Transaction amount to calculate VAT for (negative supported for credit notes).

amount_type.description: Whether 'amount' is net (exclusive of VAT) or gross (inclusive of VAT).

buyer_country.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the buyer (e.g. 'DE', 'US', 'GB').

buyer_vat_number.description: Optional buyer EU VAT number (validated offline via country checksum rules).

seller_country.description: 2-letter ISO country code of the seller (e.g. 'HU', 'DE').

supply_type.description: Category of goods or services supplied.

name: tinplate_eu_vat_calculator
